suggestions.pitch: Lloyd and Golden are non-contributors for me, while Prescott upgrades QB and Rachaad White starts at RB, adding about 92 points.
Reed projects near zero for me, and Goff plus Ertz give me a QB upgrade and a TE starter from a rebuilding team at a 0.93 acceptance chance.
